questions.question: In a 200-m linear race, if A gives B a start of 25 m, then A wins the race by 10 seconds. Alternatively, if A gives B a start of 45 m, the race ends in a dead heat. How long does A take to run 200m?
questions.solution:
**Given**

In a 200-m linear race, if A gives B a start of 25 m, then A wins the race by 10 seconds.

**Formula used**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation **

Let’s assume speed of A as vₐ and speed of B as vb

Then, in a 200 M race distance run by A = 200 m

Distance run by B after getting head start of 25 M = 175 m

Time taken by A = 200/vₐ

Time taken by B = 175/vb

Since B lacks behind by 10 sec therefore Time taken by B is more as compare to that of A by 10 sec,

⇒ 175/vb - 200/vₐ = 10 ....(1)

if A gives B a start of 45 m, the race ends in a dead heat,

Time taken by B = (200 - 45)/vb = 155/vb

Time taken by A = 200/vₐ

Both finish at same time,

∴ 155/vb = 200/vₐ

⇒ vₐ = 40/31 × vb ----(2)

Putting (2) in (1) we get,

Vb = 2 

Time taken by B to complete 200M race would be 175 / 2 = 87.5 seconds

Thus time taken by A would be = 87.5 - 10 = 77.5 second

**A takes 77.5 seconds to run 200m.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

In the first case:

A runs = 200m , B runs = (200-25)m = 175m

Let A take x s to run 200m then, B will take (x+10) s for 175m 

In the second case:

A runs = 200m, B runs = (200-45)m = 155m

Time taken by B to run 155m = time taken by A to run 200m = x s

From the first and second cases, it is clear that for (175-155)m = 20m extra run B takes 10 s extra time.

Thus speed of B = 20m/10s = 2m/s

**Therefore, Time taken by A to run 200m = Time taken by B to run 155m = 155/2 = 77.5 s**

questions.question: Ram can copy 60 pages in 15 hours. If Ram and Riya together can copy 180 pages in 30 hours, then in how many hours can Riya copy 20 pages?
questions.solution:
Given:

Ram can copy 60 pages in 15 hours.

Ram and Riya together can copy 180 pages in 30 hours

Formula Used:

Efficiency = Work done/Time Taken

Calculation:

By using the above formula

The efficiency of Ram is = 60/15= 4pages/hr

The efficiency of Ram and Riya = 180/30 = 6 pages/hr

The efficiency of Riya = 6 - 4 = 2 pages/hr

The time taken by Riya to copy 20 pages will be

⇒ 20/2= 10 hr

∴ The Time taken by Riya is 10 hours.

questions.question: A can complete a work in 9 days and B in 12 days. If they work together on it for 5 days, then the fraction of the work left is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Time taken by A to complete the work = 9 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 12 days

Calculation:

Total work = L.C.M. of (12, 9) = 36 units

Efficiency of A = 36/9 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of B = 36/12 = 3 units/day

Combined efficiency of A and B = (3 + 4) = 7 units/day

If they work together on it for 5 days = 7 × 5 = 35 unit

The fraction of the work left is = 1/36

**The fraction of the work left is 1/36**

questions.question: An airplane travels five times as fast as a bus. If the bus covers 60 km in 80 minutes, then what distance (in km) will the airplane cover in 25 minutes?
questions.solution:
Given:

An aeroplane travels five times as fast as a bus.

Time is taken by bus to cover 60 km = 1 hour 20 minutes(4/3 hour)

Formula used:

Speed = Distance/time

Calculation:

Speed of bus = 60/(4/3)

⇒ 45 km/hr

Speed of aeroplane = 5 × 45

⇒ 225 km/hr

Distance covered in 25 minutes = 225 × 25/60

⇒ 93.75 km

**Distance covered in 25 minutes by aeroplane is 93.75 km/hr. **

questions.question: The interest on a certain deposit at 4.5% p.a. is ₹135 in one year. How much will the additional interest in one year be on the same deposit at 5% p.a.?
questions.solution:
Given:

Initial R = 4.5 %

Initial interest = Rs. 135

New R = 5%

Formula used:

Simple Interest = (Principle × Rate per annum ×Time)/100

Calculation:

Let deposit = Rs. a 

⇒ 135 = (a x 4.5 x 1)/100

⇒ a = 3000

Now,

Simple interest on 5% = (3000 x 5 x 1)/100

⇒ 150

Additional interest = 150 - 135 = Rs. 15

∴ Additional interest in one year = Rs. 15

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** If 4.5 = 135

⇒ 1 = 30

⇒ 5 = 5 x 30 = 150

Additional interest = 150 - 135 = Rs.15

∴ Additional interest in one year is 15.

questions.question: The centroid of an equilateral triangle PQR is L. If PQ = 6 cm, the length of PL is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Equilateral triangle PQR with side PQ = 6 cm

Formula Used:

Circumradius of Equilateral triangle = side of equilateral triangle/√3

Concept Used:

Centroid Divide the median in the ratio 2 : 1

All the centres of the Equilateral triangle lie at the same point. Be it circumcenter, orthocenter, incentre, and centroid.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a05ec0bf5d6d72977a551a19d4a9bc38db085dc4fc4a0fde64952576ed458d2c.png] 

Since all the centres lie at the same point L, PL is also the circumradius of Equilateral Triangle PQR

Using the above formula,

PL = PQ/√3

⇒ PL = 6/√3

⇒ PL = 2√3 cm.

∴ The length of PL is 2√3 cm.

questions.question: If sin θ + cosec θ = sqrt{5}, then the value of sin³ θ + cosec³ θ = ___________.
questions.solution:
Given:

sin θ + cosec θ = √5

Concept used:

x3 + 1/x3 = (x + 1/x)3 - 3(x + 1/x)

Calculation:

sin θ + cosec θ = √5

⇒ sin θ + 1/sin θ = √5

We know that 

x3 + 1/x3 = (x + 1/x)3 - 3(x + 1/x)

Here, x = sin θ 

sin3 θ + 1/sin3 θ = (√5)3 - 3(√5)

⇒ 5√5 - 3√5 = 2√5

∴ The required answer is **2√5.**

questions.question: A, B and C together can complete a work in 12 days. A as well as B alone can do the same work in 36 days. In how many days can C alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given:

A, B and C together can finish the task in 12 days

A and B alone can finish the task in 36 days

Formula used:

Time taken = Total work/Efficiency

Calculation:

Total work be 36 units (lcm of 12 and 36)

A, B and C together can finish a task in 12 days

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 36/12

= 3 units per day

Efficiency of (A) = 36/36 = 1 unit per day.

Efficiency of (B) = 36/36 = 1 unit per day.

Efficiency of C = 3 - 2 = 1 unit per day

C alone complete the same work = 36/1 = 36 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

1-day work of (A + B + C) and (A) and (B) = (1/12) - (1/36) - (1/36) = 1/36

Total time taken by C alone = 36 days.
